annotator_disclosure: Every record was produced by an LLM (Claude) reading the cached forum thread. No human has reviewed these labels yet (reviewed_by_human=false). Each label cites a verbatim quote, its author and a post permalink so it can be checked independently; training/verify_thread_annotations.py re-checks every quote against the thread text.

labelling_guide.source_rule: A label needs a post by someone other than the original poster that names a cause, or an original-poster post confirming a found cause. Competing causes without resolution -> undiagnosed. Never use this project's rule engine or the forum search term.

certainty.explicit: cause stated plainly or confirmed by the log owner after investigation

statuses.undiagnosed: no agreed cause in the thread
statuses.not_a_failure: the log is not a failure/crash flight (test flight, on-ground log, post-crash flight)
statuses.not_reviewed: source not readable from the annotation environment

labelling_guide.label_definitions: src/diagnosis/failure_types.py, applied strictly: sudden loss of thrust from one motor/ESC/prop (failure, desync, short, wiring) = mechanical_failure; one motor persistently weaker or a weight/yaw imbalance = motor_imbalance; all motors saturated because the vehicle is underpowered = thrust_loss; flight-controller supply loss or reboot = brownout; battery voltage sag or battery connection = power_instability; configuration or calibration error (motor order, ESC calibration, MOT_ params) = setup_error; poor PID tune or oscillation = pid_tuning_issue; estimator fault = ekf_failure.
